purpose.endorsement: NONE. Archiving is an evidence-integrity act, not an evaluation. This receipt endorses no candidate, ranks no candidate, assigns no evidence strength, asserts no novelty verdict, and confers no validity on the harness. Adjudication belongs to TASK-20260731-604 (validation) and then TASK-20260731-605 (evidence and decision).

source_outcomes.reported_outcome: TWO_ADMISSIBLE_CANDIDATES, plus 5 closures and 2 recorded rediscoveries.
producer_reported_summary: CAND-601-A: projective class in P^3(GF(2^8)) of a column-restricted delta-set difference vector, measured as a pairwise GF(2^8) rank-1 collision rate at r=1..5. Lossy-projection test reported as passed, but with a self-reported survival depth of only about 1/2 round. novelty_status: adaptation; closest prior art recorded as KN-LIT-7595.

CAND-601-B: partial-sum key-guess aggregation reorganized as a 4-D Walsh-Hadamard convolution at 6 rounds. Self-labelled as a probable rediscovery of FFT key recovery for integral attacks. Cofactor-level, not exponent-moving.

CAND-601-B adjudicability limit: its claimed margin of about 4 bits is SMALLER than the plus/minus 2-bit recall uncertainty attached to the unverifiable baseline it is compared against, so the comparison is not adjudicable in this environment regardless of how its falsification gate resolves.
CAND-601-B feasibility limit: its full-scale form requires a 4 GB accumulator, which exceeds the task's 4 GB memory budget.
Network: 3 WebFetch attempts (eprint.iacr.org and two di.ens.fr PDFs) all returned HTTP 403. Zero primary sources were read. WebSearch returned a secondary summary only.
The recalled division-property obstruction cannot be checked in this environment: no MILP or SAT tooling is installed.
source_outcomes.coordinator_note: Every literature baseline in this package is unverified-from-memory under the campaign network policy. The novelty and deduplication verdicts are the validator's to render in TASK-20260731-604; nothing here settles them.

producer_reported_summary: 6000 seeded random pairs producing 12000 block comparisons against pycryptodome, with 0 mismatches.
96 openssl CLI invocations producing 3072 blocks, with 0 mismatches.

Reduced-round conventions adopted and documented: C1 the final round drops MixColumns, so r = Nr is FIPS-197 bit-for-bit; C2 the initial AddRoundKey is whitening and is not counted as a round; C3 the untruncated FIPS-197 key schedule is indexed 0..r.

The executor found and fixed a false-green in its OWN mutation control: two mutants had been scored as detected by a driver import bug rather than by any comparison. Detection now counts only the module's own AssertionError.

The executor quantified that fixed known-answer vectors are weak as a control: a sparse S-box fault escaped 2 of 4 KAT vectors and 48 of 200 random pairs. Randomized differential agreement is therefore the load-bearing check.
source_outcomes.producer_stated_principal_limitation: The reduced-round path (r < Nr) has NO external reference and cannot obtain one in this environment: no available tool implements reduced-round AES. That path is pinned only by exact three-way agreement at r = Nr plus internal convention checks.
source_outcomes.coordinator_note: The reduced-round convention is the load-bearing dependency for every later cryptanalytic claim in this campaign and is externally unreferenced. TASK-20260731-604 must return an explicit verdict on convention-versus-code consistency; this snapshot asserts none.

declared_scope_extension.statement: The TASK-20260731-603 card in dispatch_queue.json declares only the receipt path, and its constraints say to stage only the producer artifact paths and this task's own receipt. The inference amendment is one path beyond that set. It is declared here explicitly, before the commit, rather than staged silently: a scope expansion that is not declared in advance is an evidence-integrity failure.
declared_scope_extension.coordinator_rationale: The amendment establishes the admissibility basis on which the producer artifacts may be reviewed at all, so it must be durable before TASK-20260731-604 reads them. Deferring it to the TASK-20260731-605 ledger archive would have the validator review artifacts whose admissibility was settled only in an uncommitted working tree.
declared_scope_extension.required_bookkeeping: The TASK-20260731-603 card's artifact_paths in coordination/goals/GOAL-AES-001/batches/BATCH-001/dispatch_queue.json must be updated to include the amendment path so the post-commit verifier's declared set matches the commit. That file is outside this task's write_scope and was not edited here. If the dispatching session prefers not to amend the card, the alternative is to commit the amendment as its own separate isolated commit; the snapshot commit must not carry an undeclared path either way.
declared_scope_extension.resolution: Committed in isolation as 0137a051, NOT inside this snapshot commit. The amendment path lies at batch root, outside TASK-20260731-603 write_scope, and tools/research_dispatch.py requires artifact_paths to sit within write_scope, so amending the card was not admissible. declared_commit_paths above therefore lists only the producer artifacts plus this receipt.
